task: Clarify the website-advice flow and assess ECC as a source for skill discovery, installed-skill audits and learning.

explicit: User asks whether Agency Agents plus Vercel Find Skills generate the initial website idea
constraints.scope: Source comparison and recommendation refinement; no installation or website build requested.
preserve: Single primary design direction and one development workflow owner

candidates.identity: ECC (Everything Claude Code), selective advisor workflows
candidates.review_depth: Read all five listed SKILL.md files, stocktake scan.sh and quick-diff.sh, continuous-learning-v2 config, full Codex plugin README/manifest, Codex hook projection, root MCP config and issue #3742. Main README introduction/outline only. No scripts/hooks installed or executed; no full bundle audit.

fit.skill-scout: Directly relevant local/marketplace/GitHub/web discovery before creating or choosing a skill; checks actual instructions before adoption.
fit.skill-stocktake: Directly relevant inventory and overlap/currency reviews, with keep/improve/update/retire/merge recommendations and explicit explanations.
fit.search-first: Useful when selecting runtime dependencies, packages, MCPs and implementation approaches.
fit.iterative-retrieval: Optional query-refinement pattern for missing code context; pseudocode is not a semantic retrieval engine.
fit.continuous-learning-v2: Session observation and learned behavior patterns; does not establish current upstream skill knowledge or prove optimal combinations.

candidates.overlap: Scout overlaps Find Skills discovery; use Find Skills as a search channel rather than running two complete selection processes. Stocktake is more skill-specific than Agency Tool Evaluator's enterprise procurement brief. Full ECC planning/TDD/review overlaps existing Superpowers workflows.
prerequisites: Resolve actual Codex skill roots instead of copying Claude-only paths
Bash, Node.js and jq for stocktake scripts
Read supporting scripts and apply existing SkillSpector/install gates before activation
Host-specific hooks/dependencies for optional automatic learning; separate from skill text
candidates.costs: Current manifest declares MIT. Agent evaluations and any subagents consume model usage. Stocktake's 5–10/20–30 minute figures are upstream estimates, not measured here. Full plugin also bundles runtime hook/MCP integration.
uncertainties: Skill Scout ranks name/description matches and source maintenance; it is keyword-oriented and does not itself prove task fit or complete coverage.
Stocktake's current default roots are ~/.claude/skills and project .claude/skills. Packaging in the Codex plugin does not automatically adapt each skill's path assumptions.

scan.sh explicitly does not parse multiline YAML fields. It follows directory symlinks. Its inventory scope/parsing behavior needs reconciliation with this repo's read-only explicit-root inspector before reuse.

Quick Scan uses new paths and mtimes relative to evaluated_at; it does not detect every supporting-file change or upstream repository update. Full inventory errors fail; quick-diff may warn and continue. Do not interpret unchanged mtimes as current upstream verification.
Usage counts require an optional observations file. Missing data are correctly marked unmeasured, not zero, and must not justify removal.

Native Codex hook projection currently provides SessionStart bootstrap only, not continuous-learning-v2's Claude PreToolUse/PostToolUse observation hooks. Observer config defaults to enabled:false; automatic learning cannot be assumed.

Continuous-learning instructions claim 100% reliable hook capture and increase confidence when users do not correct behavior. Those are not verified guarantees; silence is not approval or correctness evidence.
Issue #3742 reports a Codex 0.164 cache fingerprint problem after dependency installs; current plugin docs describe an opt-in workaround. No reproduction or fix validation performed.
The previous-to-current compare reports 390 commits; large compare file listings may be capped, so no claim that an unlisted file was unchanged.
No comparative outcome evidence establishes that these modules outperform the existing advisor.

coverage.job: Understand the website and account for all required capabilities
coverage.reason: Task decomposition and source coverage remain the coordinating responsibility.

coverage.chosen_owner: Proposed ECC-inspired scout workflow with Find Skills as an optional registry channel
coverage.reason: Local-first discovery plus current-source vetting is more directly relevant than a generic expert persona.

coverage.chosen_owner: Existing read-only inspector plus proposed adapted stocktake review method
coverage.gap: Laptop unavailable; current Codex roots and payloads not inspected.
coverage.reason: Run a scoped audit when assessing setup changes; a full stocktake is not required before every website.
Tool discovery selects the specialist; it does not itself supply art direction.

coverage.chosen_owner: Existing development workflow with task-specific tools
coverage.reason: Keep full ECC as an alternative rather than an additional baseline; use narrow research methods as needed.
Automatic learning needs explicit host-specific setup and demonstrated behavior; it does not refresh upstream knowledge by itself.

decision.status: Proposed selective refinement, not accepted installation choices.
decision.recommendation: Prefer ECC's skill-specific scout/stocktake methods as source material for the Tool Advisor, with Find Skills as one discovery channel. Agency Tool Evaluator becomes optional for broader tool/platform comparisons. Retain the repo coverage gate, current-source/device checks and outcome evidence.
decision.refines_prior_recommendation: The preceding decision proposed adapting the generic Agency Tool Evaluator approach. Reading ECC's actual skill-specific modules provides a more direct source for the discovery and installed-skill-audit portions; no benchmarked superiority is claimed.
website_sequence: Understand the brief and required capabilities
Check relevant available/installed skills and prior decisions
Search additional candidates and read current upstream instructions
Select a compatible combination and explain deferred alternatives
Use one design specialist to develop the concept
Implement using domain specialists and one development workflow
Verify the result and save outcomes
deferred: Agency Orchestrator as a mandatory first step
Full stocktake on every website request
A second competing design or planning controller
actions_completed: Persisted recommendation refinement and routing link
not_implemented: A separately configured Tool Advisor agent

evidence.finding: Old repository name returns a move; maintained source resolves as affaan-m/ECC.
Explicit local and remote skill discovery, instruction vetting, keyword/source ranking and use/fork/create choices.
Installed-skill overlap/currency review with actionable verdicts; missing usage data not grounds for retirement; archive/delete requires explicit confirmation.
Quick changes determined from new paths and mtimes; no upstream revision fetch.
Current native Codex projection contains SessionStart bootstrap only.
Open report of Codex plugin-cache symlink fingerprint rejection; supporting workaround documented but not tested here.
Prior full-ECC review already records not-selected due to overlap with existing setup. Selective workflow research does not change that adoption status.
